spec.description: Free seats in 16 reading rooms and libraries of Karlsruhe (KIT, the Baden State Library, HKA, DHBW), live from the KIT Library's Seatfinder every 5 minutes: each room on its floor of its building, a card per building zoomed out, the week to brush over, and today against the usual day.

spec.rawSql:
-- The rooms at the end of the dashboard's time range, together: free seats, the share
-- taken, the fullest room, and when the latest count was made.
WITH rooms(code, room, label, building, site, level, floors, latitude, longitude) AS (VALUES
  ('LBS', 'Textbook collection', 'Textbooks', 'KIT-S', 'KIT Campus South', '0;1', 'Ground and 1st floor, old building', 49.01125, 8.41638),
  ('LSN', 'Science reading room', 'Science', 'KIT-S', 'KIT Campus South', '2', '2nd floor, old building', 49.01125, 8.41638),
  ('LSM', 'Media centre reading room', 'Media centre', 'KIT-S', 'KIT Campus South', '3', '3rd floor, old building', 49.01125, 8.41638),
  ('LSW', 'Economics and computer science reading room', 'Economics', 'KIT-S', 'KIT Campus South', '1', '1st floor, new building', 49.011, 8.41676),
  ('LST', 'Engineering reading room', 'Engineering', 'KIT-S', 'KIT Campus South', '2', '2nd floor, new building', 49.011, 8.41676),
  ('LSG', 'Humanities reading room', 'Humanities', 'KIT-S', 'KIT Campus South', '3', '3rd floor, new building', 49.011, 8.41676),
  ('FBI', 'Computer science library', 'Computer science', 'INF', 'KIT Campus South', '0', 'Ground floor', 49.01384, 8.42002),
  ('FBM', 'Mathematics library', 'Mathematics', 'MATH', 'KIT Campus South', '-1;0', 'Basement and ground floor', 49.01126, 8.40899),
  ('FBP', 'Physics library', 'Physics', 'PHYS', 'KIT Campus South', '2', '2nd floor', 49.01243, 8.41068),
  ('FBA', 'Architecture faculty library', 'Architecture', 'ARCH', 'KIT Campus South', '1', '1st floor', 49.01112, 8.41077),
  ('LAF', 'Learning centre', 'Learning centre', 'LAF', 'KIT Campus South', '1;2', '1st and 2nd floor', 49.01277, 8.41221),
  ('BIB-N', 'KIT Library North', 'KIT North', 'KIT-N', 'KIT Campus North', '0', 'Ground floor', 49.09473, 8.42831),
  ('BLB', 'Baden State Library', 'State Library', 'BLB', 'Karlsruhe', '0;1;2;3', 'Ground to 3rd floor', 49.00783, 8.39894),
  ('WIS', 'Wissenstor, Baden State Library', 'Wissenstor', 'WIS', 'Karlsruhe', '1;2', '1st and 2nd floor', 49.00832, 8.39866),
  ('FBH', 'HKA library', 'HKA', 'HKA', 'Karlsruhe', '1', '1st floor', 49.017499, 8.392369),
  ('FBD', 'DHBW library', 'DHBW', 'DHBW', 'Karlsruhe', '0', 'Floor not given', 49.02721, 8.38525)
),
win AS (
  SELECT w0, w1,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Berlin', w0) AS DATE) AS d0,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Berlin', w1) AS DATE) AS d1,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Berlin', now()) AS DATE) AS today
  FROM (
    SELECT greatest(to_timestamp(CAST(${__from} AS BIGINT) / 1000), w1 - INTERVAL 8 DAY) AS w0, w1
    FROM (SELECT least(to_timestamp(CAST(${__to} AS BIGINT) / 1000), now()) AS w1)
  )
),
days AS (
  SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS d, today FROM win, unnest(generate_series(d0, least(d1, today), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS g(d)
),
bodies AS (
  SELECT r->>'body' AS body
  FROM (SELECT http_get('http://feeds/kit-seatfinder/' || CASE WHEN d = today THEN 'today/' ELSE 'day/' END || strftime(d, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS r FROM days)
  WHERE (r->>'status') = '200'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT unnest(json_extract(body, '$[0].seatestimate.*[*]')) AS j, 'estimate' AS source FROM bodies
  UNION ALL
  SELECT unnest(json_extract(body, '$[0].manualcount.*[*]')) AS j, 'staff count' AS source FROM bodies
),
readings AS (
  SELECT j->>'location_name' AS code, source,
         timezone('Europe/Berlin', strptime(j->'timestamp'->>'date', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')) AS t,
         least((j->>'occupied_seats')::INTEGER, (j->>'occupied_seats')::INTEGER + (j->>'free_seats')::INTEGER) AS taken,
         greatest((j->>'free_seats')::INTEGER, 0) AS free
  FROM counts
  QUALIFY source = 'estimate' OR count(*) FILTER (WHERE source = 'estimate') OVER (PARTITION BY j->>'location_name') = 0
),
latest AS (
  SELECT readings.* FROM readings, win
  WHERE t <= w1 AND t > w1 - CASE WHEN source = 'estimate' THEN INTERVAL 20 MINUTE ELSE INTERVAL 4 HOUR END
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY t DESC) = 1
)
SELECT sum(l.free)::DOUBLE AS "Free seats",
       100.0 * sum(l.taken) / nullif(sum(l.taken + l.free), 0) AS "Seats taken",
       arg_max(r.label || ', ' || round(100.0 * l.taken / nullif(l.taken + l.free, 0))::INTEGER || ' %',
               l.taken / nullif(l.taken + l.free, 0)) AS "Fullest",
       epoch_ms(max(l.t)) AS "Counted",
       count(l.code)::DOUBLE AS "Rooms counted"
FROM rooms r JOIN latest l USING (code)

spec.description: The share of seats taken in those rooms: green under half, yellow from half, orange from 80 %, red from 95 %.
spec.title: Seats taken

options.content:
**Where it comes from.** The KIT Library's [Seatfinder](https://seatfinder.bibliothek.kit.edu/), which shows the free study places of Karlsruhe's libraries: the KIT Library's reading rooms and faculty libraries, the Baden State Library, and the libraries of HKA and DHBW Karlsruhe. Read by the server through Pacha's gateway, which asks the Seatfinder once for each day, whoever is looking.

- **Estimates**: every 5 minutes, the Seatfinder estimates the seats taken in a room from the number of devices on its Wi-Fi access points (and wired ports, where it can), with a model trained on the staff's counts. It knows the number of devices only, never which: no device or person can be found from it.
- **Staff counts**: where the devices cannot be counted (here the HKA, DHBW and Mathematics libraries), the staff count the seats now and then; a count stays on the map for 4 hours, an estimate for 20 minutes. A room with neither shows *no count now*: mostly, it is closed. The Chemistry library is left out: it has had no count since December 2024.
- **The buildings**: their outlines and heights from [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright) (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), or 3.5 m a storey where no height is mapped. The rooms themselves are not mapped there, so a room is a ring on its floor of its building, not a shape; the six reading rooms of KIT Library South stand on their wing, the old building (the tower) or the new one. The DHBW library's floor is not given: it stands on the ground floor.

**How to read it.** The map opens inside KIT Library South, on its 2nd floor. The picker on the left lists the floors of the building in view with the free seats on each; zoom out and each building, then each site (KIT Campus South, KIT Campus North, Karlsruhe), becomes a card with its free seats; click a card to go in. A ring is the share of a room's seats taken: green under half, yellow from half, orange from 80 %, red from 95 %. The callout above it is the room's free seats over the Time Brush's window.

**The Time Brush** at the top is the last week hour by hour, its window the dashboard's time range (the last 12 hours when it opens). The map, the cards and the table show the counts at the window's end, the callouts the free seats over it; at the latest hour they are live, and the dashboard reloads every 5 minutes. **Through the day** is today against the usual weekday and weekend of the last four weeks, for the room clicked on the map or picked in the table.

The Seatfinder's data come with no stated licence; they are shown here as the Seatfinder shows them, with its name and a link.

spec.rawSql:
-- The last 7 days and today, hour by hour: the seats taken in the rooms the Seatfinder
-- estimates (the staff counts are too sparse to add up), the mean of each hour. A picture
-- to brush over: its window is the dashboard's time range, what the map, the cards and the
-- table show. It reads its own days, whatever the time range.
WITH days AS (
  SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS d, today
  FROM (SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Berlin', now()) AS DATE) AS today),
       unnest(generate_series(today - 7, today, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS g(d)
),
bodies AS (
  SELECT r->>'body' AS body
  FROM (SELECT http_get('http://feeds/kit-seatfinder/' || CASE WHEN d = today THEN 'today/' ELSE 'day/' END || strftime(d, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS r FROM days)
  WHERE (r->>'status') = '200'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT unnest(json_extract(body, '$[0].seatestimate.*[*]')) AS j, 'estimate' AS source FROM bodies
  UNION ALL
  SELECT unnest(json_extract(body, '$[0].manualcount.*[*]')) AS j, 'staff count' AS source FROM bodies
),
readings AS (
  SELECT j->>'location_name' AS code, source,
         timezone('Europe/Berlin', strptime(j->'timestamp'->>'date', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')) AS t,
         least((j->>'occupied_seats')::INTEGER, (j->>'occupied_seats')::INTEGER + (j->>'free_seats')::INTEGER) AS taken,
         greatest((j->>'free_seats')::INTEGER, 0) AS free
  FROM counts
  QUALIFY source = 'estimate' OR count(*) FILTER (WHERE source = 'estimate') OVER (PARTITION BY j->>'location_name') = 0
)
SELECT timezone('UTC', h) AS time, sum(taken)::DOUBLE AS "Seats taken"
FROM (SELECT code, time_bucket(INTERVAL 1 HOUR, t) AS h, avg(taken) AS taken FROM readings WHERE source = 'estimate' GROUP BY ALL)
GROUP BY h
